answer: Post-deployment monitoring can help mitigate risks from both asset gain and continual learning by continuously assessing and re-evaluating deployed AI models as new techniques and capabilities emerge. For asset gain, monitoring can involve collaboration with national security authorities to improve elicitation processes and ensure that the integration of restricted assets does not lead to unforeseen dangerous capabilities. For continual learning, post-deployment monitoring can help identify and address any drift in model behavior that may occur as the model acquires new knowledge, ensuring that previously safe models do not evolve into unsafe behaviors. This ongoing evaluation allows for timely interventions and adjustments to maintain safety and alignment with intended use.
